title: "Charty Party xFP"
output: html_document
date: "2026-10-13"
---
```{r, echo=FALSE}

library(tidyverse)
library(nflfastR)
library(gt)
library(ggthemes)
library(ffopportunity)
# load in the play-by-play data (2025/26)
pbp26 <- load_pbp(2026)
pbp25_26 <- load_pbp(2025:2026)
# pbp20_26<- load_pbp(2020:2026)
# pbp2k<- load_pbp(2016:2026)

snaps <- nflreadr::load_snap_counts(2026)

```


```{r, echo=FALSE}

Week <- 6

ep <- ep_load(
  season = 2026,
  type = "weekly"
) %>%
  filter(
    week >= pmax(1, Week - 3),
    week <= Week
  )

Weeks_In_Sample <- length(unique(ep$week))

Week_Label <- paste0(
  "Weeks ",
  max(1, Week - 3),
  "-",
  Week
)

receiver_xfp <- ep %>%
  filter(position == "WR") %>%
  group_by(
    player_id,
    full_name,
    posteam
  ) %>%
  summarize(
    games = n(),

    targets = sum(
      rec_attempt,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    xfp = sum(
      rec_fantasy_points_exp,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    fpts = sum(
      rec_fantasy_points,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    xfp_pg = xfp / games,
    fpts_pg = fpts / games,

    fpts_over_exp = fpts - xfp,

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    targets >= 15
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    teams_colors_logos,
    by = c("posteam" = "team_abbr")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    teams_colors_logos %>%
      select(
        team_abbr,
        team_logo_espn
      ),
    by = c("posteam" = "team_abbr")
  )

TE_xfp <- ep %>%
  filter(position == "TE") %>%
  group_by(
    player_id,
    full_name,
    posteam
  ) %>%
  summarize(
    games = n(),

    targets = sum(
      rec_attempt,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    xfp = sum(
      rec_fantasy_points_exp,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    fpts = sum(
      rec_fantasy_points,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    xfp_pg = xfp / games,
    fpts_pg = fpts / games,

    fpts_over_exp = fpts - xfp,

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    targets >= 10
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    teams_colors_logos,
    by = c("posteam" = "team_abbr")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    teams_colors_logos %>%
      select(
        team_abbr,
        team_logo_espn
      ),
    by = c("posteam" = "team_abbr")
  )

rb_xfp <- ep %>%
  filter(position == "RB") %>%
  group_by(
    player_id,
    full_name,
    posteam
  ) %>%
  summarize(
    games = n(),

    opportunities = sum(
      rush_attempt + rec_attempt,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    opp_pg = opportunities / games,

    xfp = sum(
      total_fantasy_points_exp,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    fp = sum(
      total_fantasy_points,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    xfp_pg = xfp / games,

    fp_pg = fp / games,

    fp_over_exp = fp - xfp,

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    opp_pg >= 6.5
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    teams_colors_logos,
    by = c("posteam" = "team_abbr")
  )


    
```




```{r RB xFP, echo=FALSE}
ggplot( rb_xfp, aes( x = xfp_pg, y = fp_pg ) ) + geom_abline( slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50" ) +
  
  nflplotR::geom_nfl_logos( aes(team_abbr = posteam), width = .025 ) + ggrepel::geom_text_repel( aes(label = full_name), size = 1.8, box.padding = 0.3, point.padding = 0.8, force = 1, force_pull = 0.2, segment.alpha = 0.3, segment.size = 0.25, seed = 123, max.overlaps = Inf ) + 
  
  annotate( "label", x = max(rb_xfp$xfp_pg, na.rm = TRUE) * .50, y = max(rb_xfp$fp_pg, na.rm = TRUE) * .85, label = "Efficient/Overperforming", fill = NA, color = "darkgreen", fontface = "bold", size = 2.25 ) + 
  annotate( "label", x = min(rb_xfp$xfp_pg, na.rm = TRUE) + 15, y = min(rb_xfp$fp_pg, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.5, label = "Inefficient/Underperforming", fill = NA, color = "darkred", fontface = "bold", size = 2.25 ) + 
  coord_cartesian( xlim = c( min(rb_xfp$xfp_pg, na.rm = TRUE) - 1, max(rb_xfp$xfp_pg, na.rm = TRUE) + 2 ) ) + 
  labs( x = "Expected Fantasy Points Per Game", y = "Fantasy Points Per Game", title = "RB xFP vs Actual Fantasy Points", subtitle = paste0( Week_Label, ", Data via ffopportunity, @rohinmishra" ) ) + 
  theme_bw() + theme( plot.title = element_text( size = 18, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5 ), plot.subtitle = element_text( size = 10, hjust = 0.5 ) )
```

```{r EPA/CPOE, echo=FALSE}
  cpoe_pad <- 1.5

qb_epa_cpoe <- pbp26 %>%
  filter(
    week >= Week-3,
    week <= Week,
    qb_dropback == 1,
    !is.na(passer_player_name)
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    passer_player_id,
    passer_player_name
  ) %>%
  summarize(
    team = last(posteam),

    dropbacks = n(),

    epa_play = mean(
      epa,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    cpoe = mean(
      cpoe,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    dropbacks >= (12 * Weeks_In_Sample)
  )

ggplot(
  qb_epa_cpoe,
  aes(
    x = cpoe,
    y = epa_play
  )
) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = mean(
      qb_epa_cpoe$epa_play,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "gray60"
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = mean(
      qb_epa_cpoe$cpoe,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "gray60"
  ) +
  nflplotR::geom_nfl_logos(
    aes(team_abbr = team),
    width = .035
  ) +
ggrepel::geom_text_repel( aes(label = passer_player_name), size = 1.8, box.padding = 0.5, point.padding = 1, force = 1.1, force_pull = 0.2, segment.alpha = 0.3, segment.size = 0.25, seed = 123, max.overlaps = Inf ) +
  annotate(
    "label",
    x = max(qb_epa_cpoe$cpoe, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.1,
    y = max(qb_epa_cpoe$epa_play, na.rm = TRUE) * .95,
    label = "HOOPERS",
    fill = NA,
    color = "#228B22",
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 2.25
  ) +
coord_cartesian(
  xlim = c(
    min(qb_epa_cpoe$cpoe, na.rm = TRUE) - cpoe_pad,
    max(qb_epa_cpoe$cpoe, na.rm = TRUE) + cpoe_pad
  )
) +
  annotate(
    "label",
    x = min(qb_epa_cpoe$cpoe, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.95,
    y = min(qb_epa_cpoe$epa_play, na.rm = TRUE) * .95,
    label = "POOPERS",
    fill = NA,
    color = "red",
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 2.25
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Completion Percentage Over Expected (CPOE)",
    y = "EPA per Play",
    title = "QB EPA/Play vs CPOE",
    subtitle = paste0(Week_Label, ", Data via nflR, @rohinmishra" )
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      size = 22,
      hjust = 0.5,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      size = 13,
      hjust = 0.5
    )
  )

```
